existing_native_bit_algorithm.slot_layout: unsigned little-endian uint32 digest 4-byte windows modulo m, 3 slots

hypothesis: A fixed three-hash bit-level association memory can hold and compose all already-observed 82 source triples with zero false negatives, but false-positive composition may make some payload capacities unsuitable. Identify the smallest predeclared capacity meeting precision and FPR thresholds, counting its vocabulary and all provenance separately.
identifiability: Development-only once over immutable, already observed F32/F35/F39 rows. All arms encode identical facts in identical order and share the exact candidate vocabulary and two-hop root queries; no unknown-source or held-out-transfer claim.
exact_candidate_domain: Every original QID subject or object, every observed PID, all root x first predicate x second predicate x terminal QID; all membership QID x PID x QID, with exact bounded graph evidence as truth (absence is not universal falsehood).
incremental_protocol: Program first 33 historical triples and cold-restore; then append all 49 FIT triples without resetting the bits. Preserve all 33 source memberships and recognize all new 49. Cold-restore final bitmap; require exact query parity with warm bitmap.
strong_controls: Same-82-fact exact symbolic adjacency and exact triple membership, including memory and candidate index costs
F34 frozen 512-bit bitmap must reproduce the parameterized implementation at 512 bits
Zero-fact bitmap negative must return no associations
Deterministic wrong-endpoint or hash tamper must change queried result / be rejected
winner_selection: Among predeclared capacities only, choose the LOWEST bit capacity that passes all of recall, twohop precision, FPR, cold-restored parity and payload bytes < 82*12=984; if none, DEV_NO_GO. No post-result retuning/extra capacities.
required_metrics: exact positive membership, total candidate membership domain and false positives/negatives
witnessed graph two-hop path count and unique query count
full two-hop TP/FP/FN/TN, precision, recall, FPR
exact symbolic control precision and recall
original 33 facts retained after later FIT 49
bit payload bytes per candidate; compare 82*12=984 raw coordinate bytes
candidate vocabulary lower bound 4*(78+observed_predicates) bytes; excludes source label/provenance receipts
per-arm source-free wall-time optionally, not used for scientific threshold
science_status: NOT_SCIENCE_SOURCE_ONLY_DEV; exact symbolic correctness ceiling; no causal action/consequence, learned transfer, native recipient or fully-trained conventional baseline
research_stop: If frozen fixed bit family is inferior to exact control under source-growth or no candidate meets thresholds, preserve negative and pivot architecture, do not tune same test.
